design: 9 ordinary/coupled + 3 clipped; shared chosen architecture/training schedule and development evaluation population

objective.answer: -expm1(-kappa * surprisal) / kappa; ordinary surprisal at kappa=0
objective.boundary: rejection CE formula is unchanged but shared parameters may change its predictions; kappa does not repair the rejection boundary
objective.finite_precision: not uniformly bounded; float32 expm1 overflows near kappa*log(p/q)>88.7
objective.interpretation: bounded answer surprisal with convex preservation f-divergence; not a proof that the entire objective equals a published coupled entropy/free energy
objective.mapping: Nelson-Umarov ln_Q(x)=(x^Q-1)/Q; ln_Q(1/p)=-ln_{-Q}(p); implemented -ln_kappa(p) maps to Q=-kappa
objective.proof: For normalized positive p,q, D=sum q*f(p/q), f(t)=(t^(1+k)-t)/k; f(1)=0, f''(t)=(1+k)t^(k-1)>0. Jensen gives D>=0; equality and stationary q-logits at q=p.
objective.reference: episode-fixed reference; coupled_divergence does not itself detach its first argument

aggregation.clip_role: Report kappa05 vs clip2 descriptively on identical metrics. No ceiling-matched claim for kappa02.
aggregation.direction: An increase may meet separation but cannot be described as improved robustness; reduction is required for an improvement claim.
aggregation.inferential_scope: development pilot, no confirmatory p-values or causal heavy-tail claim
aggregation.missingness: Never drop seeds/datasets or select checkpoint by observed tail performance.
aggregation.retention: For each arm compute RET-GS at the predeclared final pilot checkpoint per dataset/seed; equal-weight mean of 9 values. Each coupled candidate must be >= ordinary macro mean minus .02.
aggregation.seed_spread_rule: For each metric average the 3 datasets within each seed. Compare each coupled arm's 3-seed mean with ordinary's; require abs(mean difference) > max(range of coupled seed macros, range of ordinary seed macros). Print the signed difference. This is exploratory separation, not a significance test.
tail_metrics: empirical ES95 of positive harm (fractional boundary weights)
aggregation.tail_population: Same frozen ordinary-text windows/positions for all arms and seeds; positive per-token NLL increase relative to original base. Compare only complete identically keyed populations; any missing/nonfinite cell makes the gate unavailable.
aggregation.unseen: For each dataset, arithmetic mean false-fire rate across the same 3 seeds must not exceed ordinary's dataset mean; report every seed as well.

comparator_interpretation: clip2 ceiling-matches kappa05 only. kappa02 is a secondary unmatched dose. Ceiling-matching both requires clip5 and 15 total trainings, a separate scope/budget amendment.

training.ordinary_arm: reused, not retrained: r1_50_stream_sel6_text_s{0,1,2} (the v5 candidate family; same command with κ = 0)
training.final_checkpoint: uniform average of steps 150, 200, 250, 300 (scripts/r1_71_average_checkpoints.py), as for primary v5 — predeclared, never chosen on tail outcomes

evaluation.retention: scripts/r1_13_stream_eval.py per dataset (stream seed 21; MQuAKE dev v3b), delta 5 / 0.1, null 0.5, rare-overlap 1 — RET-GS at the averaged checkpoint
evaluation.tail: scripts/r1_54_drift_assay.py --windows 32 --window 128 --rules 0.5:none --rare-overlap 1 --save-positions per dataset: 32 shared windows × 127 positions = 4,064 positions per dataset, per-position cap-on and cap-off NLL saved; positive harm = max(cap-on − cap-off, 0); ES95 with fractional boundary weights and maximum per aggregation rule
evaluation.population_note: the 32-window assay population is identical for every arm and seed (deterministic window draw per dataset); it is not the 128-window driver population used in HT-1b

budget.basis: training 1,033 s per run (measured, sel6_text_s2) × 9 + averaging + retention 3 × 30 s + unseen 3 × 90 s + tail 3 × ~180 s per arm-seed; ordinary arm needs tail rows and CounterFact/MQuAKE unseen only; the v2 figure of 3 h did not include evaluation
budget.policy: failures are charged (failure receipts); no seed or dataset dropped; the chain stops at the first non-finite abort of an arm and reports it
